HierarchicalPartsPkg.name: HierarchicalPartsPkg
HierarchicalPartsPkg.documentation: Diagram examples for hierarchical parts and nested ports. PartDefinitions shows nested function domains. NestedPorts shows serviceA/client with conjugated hierarchical sPort joined by LayeredInterface.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts.name: NestedPorts
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts.documentation: Service/client hierarchical ports. serviceA exposes sPort with nested sP1/sP2, bound inward to children s1/s2. client exposes the conjugated ~sPort and binds nested ends to c1.cP1 / c2.cP2 (conjugated leaf types). LayeredInterface joins the composite faces serviceA.sPort to client.sPort.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sP1.name: sP1
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sP1.documentation: Service-side leaf of the first layer.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sP2.name: sP2
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sP2.documentation: Service-side leaf of the second layer.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sPort.name: sPort
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::sPort.documentation: Composite service face. Nested sP1 and sP2 expand onto every usage; the client uses the conjugated type ~sPort.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Layer.name: LayeredInterface
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Layer.documentation: Joins a service sPort to a client ~sPort as one hierarchical connection.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::C1::c.name: cP1
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::C1::c.documentation: Conjugated counterpart of sP1; bound to client.sPort.sP1.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::C2::c.name: cP2
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::C2::c.documentation: Conjugated counterpart of sP2; bound to client.sPort.sP2.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Servi.name: ServiceA
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Servi.documentation: Service assembly: hierarchical sPort proxied into s1/s2.

HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Clien.name: Client
HierarchicalPartsPkg::NestedPorts::Clien.documentation: Client assembly: conjugated ~sPort proxied into c1/c2.
